items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Ferguson had the band in the project where I used to live, and I used to go down and listen to them rehearse

ctx.x: know. I used to go down into the project and listen to Fergie... Mr. Ferguson had the band in the project where I used to live, and I used to go down and listen to them rehearse, the WPA bands.

And they had all kinds of music going on around there. There was another place that had (?) music called Little Sam's, down in Black Bottom, way over into the ghetto. I used to work down in there, you know! [LAUGHS] I did some getting-around, all right.
